title: rosa pendulina f. subglobosa
intro: Rosa pendulina f. subglobosa, commonly known as Dwarf Alpine Rose, is a compact, shrub-like plant species within the Rosa genus. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which may include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to improved cardiovascular health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pendulina f. subglobosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential and confirm its bioactive constituents.
